_why: Curated furigana corrections for the Japanese Executive Summary. kuromoji + IPADIC is a statistical analyser: it reads ordinary prose well but picks the wrong reading for a handful of words whose meaning is abstract — exactly the register this document is written in. Every entry below was found by reading the analyser's output against the text in context, and each is listed with the evidence. Corrections are applied by scripts/exec-summary-furigana.mjs at generation time; the generated readings are committed, so what ships is reviewable.
_token_why: Keyed SURFACE|WRONG-READING so a correction fires ONLY where the analyser produced that specific wrong reading. This is deliberate: 人 must stay にん in 三人 and なん in 何百万, so a blanket 人 → ひと would break more than it fixed. Matching the wrong reading leaves every correct instance untouched.

生|なま.why: 生 here is 'life', not 'raw'. Contexts: 人間の生の尺度 · あらゆる人間の生がその中を生きる · 自らの生に影響するシステム. IPADIC defaults to なま. 6 occurrences.

金|きん.why: 金 here is 'money', not the metal 'gold'. Contexts: テクノロジーからでも、金からでも · 金は主権ではない. 3 occurrences.

金|きむ.why: きむ is a Korean surname reading and is simply wrong here — same 'money' sense. Context: それは、金、インフラ、専門知識. 1 occurrence.

人|じん.why: Standalone 人 = ひと. Context: 何百万もの人がそれを. (The じん reading belongs to compounds like 人類/人工, which tokenise separately and are untouched.) 1 occurrence.

_phrase_why: Whole-phrase readings, applied as group ruby over the run. Used where the correct reading is a property of the phrase rather than of its parts — Japanese sound-change (sandhi) across a counter, or a word the dictionary cannot read at all.

一分.why: The counter 分 becomes っぷん after 一. Token-by-token the analyser yields いち + ふん = いちふん, which no speaker says. This phrase is load-bearing here — 'one minute lived in Austin' is the document's founding image. 2 occurrences.

六十分.why: Same counter sandhi: ろくじゅう + ふん is not how 六十分 is read. Context: 六十分でトーク. 1 occurrence.

閾値.why: 閾 carries NO reading in IPADIC, so this word would have shipped with no furigana at all — a silent gap precisely where the reader most needs help, since 閾 is a rare character. 2 occurrences.
